posts.title: Tahsin International launches its new corporate website
posts.author: Tahsin International
posts.excerpt: Our new website brings our full range of services, credentials and contact channels together in one place — with an online RFQ system for faster quotations.
posts.body:
We are pleased to launch the new Tahsin International website — a single, accountable home for our multi-sector capabilities across government contracting, electrical works, global trade, logistics, manpower, travel and investment.

What you can do here

  • Explore our eleven licensed service verticals across four capability domains.
  • Submit a Request for Quotation (RFQ) and receive a costed quotation with compliance documentation.
  • Verify our registrations — Electrical Contractor Licence, IRC, VAT/BIN, TIN and chamber memberships.
  • Reach our team directly by phone, WhatsApp or email.

This News & Blog section will carry company updates, tender notices and sector notes. Check back regularly, or get in touch for anything specific.
